thread:
nina: quick heads-up: saw a weird trace gap in the polyglot sampleapps. When the auth refresh path retries, the request-id either disappears or becomes `REDACTED` depending on the language. correlation across logs/spans broken. anyone else? :thinking:

omar_sdk: which sampleapp and flow? node/go/python? any minimal repro?

nina: happened in all three during a perf smoke. Pattern: incoming request has X-Request-ID, token expired -> refresh + retry -> downstream logs show either no x-request-id or a redacted value. suspect two separate root causes.

lucy_sre: likely candidates: 1) async/context propagation loss (detached tasks/new async contexts), 2) header redaction code collapsing header maps when masking Authorization. both would lead to missing req-id.

pat_devexp: we should treat them separately in the tickets. quick language notes from yesterday: Node tends to lose headers when axios-retry issues new requests; Python loses context when using create_task without copying contextvars; Go client wrappers sometimes don't copy inbound headers on retry.

nina: exact logs from Node run (redacted for tokens):
```
INFO auth: got headers {"authorization":"Bearer ***","x-request-id":"r-2026-01"}
WARN auth: token expired, refreshing
DEBUG http: retry outgoing headers {"authorization":"Bearer ***"}
INFO proxy: downstream processed without req_id
```

omar_sdk: that shows lost header copy. short-term Node fix: add axios interceptor that always injects x-request-id from current context into outgoing requests (covers retries). we'll add as opt-in in SDK template.

lucy_sre: Python excerpt showed a different failure: create_task used in middleware during refresh path so contextvars (and otel) weren't preserved. sample fix is using contextvars.copy_context() and ctx.run() when scheduling background work.

pat_devexp: Go variant: internal client used in auth middleware relied on default http.Client; our retry wrapper returned a new Request without copying headers. patch is to clone headers explicitly before retries. also add a small helper in sdk-common to copy req-id from incoming to outgoing requests.

nina: ok pragmatic plan: 1) quick sampleapp patches per language (Node interceptor, Python ctx.run shim, Go header clone) + unit/integration tests; 2) fix platform redactor so masking Authorization doesn't flatten the entire header map; 3) add CI integration test that runs the refresh + retry path and asserts identical x-request-id in initial request, outgoing retries, logs, and spans.

omar_sdk: for SDK parity, let's add a short "Retry-aware propagation" section to devex-sdks: show Node axios interceptor, Python context example, and Go helper. also mark it as recommended for any custom auth/retry logic.

lucy_sre: redactor fix: change behavior from "collapse headers to single redacted string" to key-by-key masking (preserve non-sensitive keys). we'll need a migration note in the logging pipeline in case some log lines relied on collapsed strings. file ticket for ops to patch and add test verifying x-request-id preserved after redaction.

pat_devexp: tests: unit tests for interceptor/wrapper, and an end-to-end telemetry test in CI harness that asserts the same req id is present on the server span and in the final downstream log line. add flaky guard to rerun only on the oauth-refresh smoke job.

nina: i've started a small repro repo and will open three PRs (node/python/go) with changes + tests. putting a temporary runtime toggle for staging: `TELEMETRY_PROPAGATE_REQID=true` that adds the shim until we ship proper SDK templates. i'll paste PR links when ready.

ci-bot: rollout: canary for auth-refresh-fixes started at 2026-03-24T09:41:00Z; monitoring for req-id preservation.

omar_sdk: once PRs land ping #eng-runtime and #devex so we can fold into sampleapp templates and the SDK quickstart. document should call out the redaction caveat explicitly so teams don't lose request ids when they redact Authorization.

nina: thanks all. will follow up with PRs and a short doc snippet. leaving a note in the staging runbook: "If traces break on refresh path, enable TELEMETRY_PROPAGATE_REQID and re-run oauth-refresh smoke tests." :memo:
